rationale: I accept this exact v19 quick catalog and its bound native live audit. The catalog retains all 85 initially quality-approved authored boards byte-for-byte in authored semantics, with no exclusions; all 45 Intrusul and 40 Perechi rated payloads, categories, difficulties and source identities match their reviewed candidates. The 322 public node snapshots cover exactly the payload concepts. Scores remain bounded, every standard rank equals one plus the number of higher-scoring boards in its game, and starter ranks apply the same competition rule only among eligible boards; 38 Intrusul and 35 Perechi boards are starter-eligible and all other starter ranks are null. My own initial review digest is bound in the proposal. Candidate KG, rubric and frozen core-payload bindings match the catalog, and the catalog KG, rubric, current pack and core-catalog bindings agree with the exact audit source manifest. The native audit records preservation of frozen core boards and covers every rated board exactly once through ordinary public seeded selection: all 85 runs score 1000, preserve hidden answers before resolution, and preserve the terminal result on GET reload. Its 460 requests and 156 unique runtime-source digests provide complete bound replay evidence for this catalog. No material quality concern remains.
